assumptions: The bootstrap creates claims_owner and claims_app before Liquibase and grants claims_owner CREATE on public schema. Test support mirrors that bootstrap prerequisite.
Failed outbox records remain eligible for retry once next_attempt_at is reached; pending() includes both pending and failed statuses, and markDelivered handles either status.
Claim and audit UUIDs and audit sequence are supplied by the application; claims_app has no UPDATE/DELETE privileges on claim_audit.
known_limitations: No build, test, Docker, database, or Git command was run, per worker packet.
The package resource target configured in pom.xml is db/; tests resolve the changelog from db/db.changelog-master.yml.
